newsitem.title: UK: Inchcape edges higher on disposal news.
newsitem.headline: Inchcape edges higher on disposal news.

text.p: Shares in Inchcape Plc edged higher in pre-market trading on Wednesday following news of the motors and distribution group's sale of its Inchcape Testing Services (ITS) unit for 380 million stg, traders said.
The ITS sale to Charterhouse Development Capital Ltd will give rise to an exceptional profit before tax of around 180 million stg. By 0721 GMT Inchcape shares were up 5p at 273p.

"I'd been hoping for a price of around 350 million pounds so this is the top of end of expectations. It is marginally dilutionary -- about four percent -- but people were aware of that," said an analyst.
Attention will now move to the group's plans insurance broker Bain Hogg which Inchcape has said it intends to demerge.
"After that, they'll be a much more focused group," added the analyst.
Inchcape said today's move was a major step in focusing the company as an international distribution group and proceeds would be used to reduce group borrowings.
